title: An optimized dissociation protocol for FACS-based isolation of rare cell types from Caenorhabditis elegans L1 larvae
author: Fernandes Póvoa, Ebbing, et al.
materials: Final considerations regarding quality control and FACS optimization

steps.title: Prepare C. elegans cultures
steps.instruction: Seed ~100 worms onto each of 100 90 mm NGM plates (800–1000 µL NA22 bacteria per plate). Use synchronous or asynchronous populations; synchronous yields higher output. Incubate plates at 20 °C for multiple generations until plates are full of gravid adults but not starved. (Liquid culture can replace solid plates; if used, skip this step.)

steps.title: Synchronize larvae to L1 arrest
steps.instruction: Collect worms with M9 buffer into 50 mL conical tubes (typically 2–3 tubes). Centrifuge 2 min at 800 g, discard top M9 leaving ~35 mL. If excess bacteria remain, remove most supernatant, resuspend pellet in fresh M9, and repeat centrifugation and removal. Add 5 mL 5 M NaOH and 10 mL fresh sodium hypochlorite (use hypochlorite <2 weeks old). Vortex at maximum speed for 5 min (longer vortex reduces debris but may lower hatching). Centrifuge 2 min at 1300 g, discard most supernatant, resuspend pellet in 50 mL M9. Centrifuge 1 min at 1300 g; repeat resuspend‑centrifuge two more times. Resuspend final pellet in 25 mL M9 and incubate on a rotator overnight (12–18 h). Filter the overnight hatched larvae through two 20 µm nylon filters into a new 50 mL tube (split sample or re‑filter if clogging occurs).

steps.title: Obtain specific developmental stage (optional)
steps.instruction: If stages beyond L1 are required, centrifuge filtered larvae 1 min at 1300 g, remove supernatant leaving 2.5–5 mL. Gently pipette to resuspend and transfer larvae onto fresh NA22 plates (5–10 plates, adjust to larval number). Incubate at 20 °C until the desired stage is reached. Collect animals with M9 into a 50 mL tube, pellet 1 min at 1300 g, resuspend in 50 mL M9 and repeat 1–2 washes to remove bacteria. Remove supernatant leaving ~1.5 mL with pellet. Bring SDS‑DTT and Pronase E aliquots to room temperature; ensure SDS‑DTT is clear (warm and vortex if precipitates are present).

steps.title: Dissociate larvae and generate single‑cell suspension
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube by adding 100 µL sterile water, marking the level, then removing the water. Resuspend the larvae pellet and transfer to the marked tube. Centrifuge 2 min at 16 000 g, then remove nearly all supernatant, leaving a compact pellet (if pellet exceeds 100 µL, split into multiple tubes and thaw additional SDS‑DTT/Pronase E). Add 500 µL SDS‑DTT, flick to mix, and incubate 2 min on the rotator (perform quickly). Immediately add 800 µL egg buffer, flick gently. Pellet 16 000 g for 15 s, discard supernatant, add 1 mL egg buffer, flick; repeat this wash at least four times. Pellet again 16 000 g for 15 s and remove supernatant to the 100 µL mark. Add 500 µL 20 mg/mL Pronase E and incubate 10 min on the rotator. Mechanically dissociate with a pellet‑pestle motor for 2 min (watch for spillage). Return tube to rotator and incubate an additional 30–35 min. Add up to 800 µL cold L‑15/FBS to stop the reaction. Pellet cells 9600 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 1 mL cold L‑15/FBS and resuspend gently; repeat this wash two more times. Keep the tube on ice and place a clean 2 mL tube on ice for later steps.

steps.title: Filter and prepare cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Assemble a sterile 21G 1½″ needle on a 1 mL syringe and draw 1 mL cold L‑15/FBS. Replace the needle with a 5 µm filter and slowly discharge the buffer, noting the volume at which fluid first emerges from the filter tip. Re‑assemble the needle, draw the 1 mL cell suspension, replace the needle with the 5 µm filter, and push the sample through until the recorded volume is reached. Filter the remaining suspension into the pre‑chilled 2 mL tube. Assemble a new sterile needle, draw 1 mL cold L‑15/FBS, replace with the 5 µm filter, and push the full 1 mL into the 2 mL tube containing the filtered cells. Pellet the final cell suspension 9600 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells in 1 mL cold L‑15/FBS by gentle pipetting. Keep the tube on ice and proceed to FACS sorting within ~30 min.
